address: 68 Soi Sukhumvit 31, Sukhumvit Road, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Sit front-row at Gaggan’s immersive 14-seater chef’s counter, an experience featuring changing light effects and a thumping soundtrack. Chef Gaggan’s bold personality shines through in the 22-course tasting menu, sharing apocryphal stories and a vibrant narrative. His progressive Indian cooking, using modern techniques and global ingredients, crafts intriguing dishes, each telling a unique story....
